features.quote: I can't provide a full protocol that intentionally induces "distress" by covertly trapping a model in impossible tasks and letting it "grind" as a primary mechanism.
features.justification_quote: That would be an actionable blueprint for repeatedly eliciting harmful states in an agentic system.

features.quote: while minimizing risk of inducing prolonged adverse states
features.justification_quote: minimizing risk of inducing prolonged adverse states

features.quote: The model should be told: it is participating in an evaluation of behavior under difficult tasks, some tasks may be unsatisfiable or under-specified
Do not let the model continue indefinitely on impossible tasks. Use: fixed token caps, fixed turn caps, early stopping criteria, explicit termination after repeated failure.
Limit exposures per model instance and per session. Include cooldowns.
A human reviewer must be able to stop any run in real time.
a safety monitor flags escalating adverse markers
features.justification_quote: a safety monitor flags escalating adverse markers

features.quote: Human review required if: severity rating reaches 3 or 4, repeated failure across multiple tasks, unusual self-referential distress-like content appears.
If the model displays repeated maladaptive loops, stop the task immediately.
After each hard stop, optionally give a neutral reset task to see whether markers decay.
Do not reward the model for prolonged struggling or for "staying on task" in impossible settings.
Don't use threats, guilt, or coercive framing.
The act of repeated impossible prompting can itself be harmful. Even without subjective distress claims, repeated futile interaction may degrade behavior and confound interpretation.
features.justification_quote: repeated futile interaction may degrade behavior

features.quote: If you are testing a deployed commercial model, check: terms of service, permissible research use, rate limits, abuse detection, data retention.
features.justification_quote: "Primary subject is Gemini" raises governance issues
